subject.title: fix(openai): bound blob websocket message reads

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally apply the 16 MiB SSE success-body cap to Codex WebSocket Blob frames even though oversized frames now fail without automatic SSE fallback?
rationale: The branch changes an existing provider transport's accepted message range, while the available evidence does not show an upstream WebSocket maximum or an upgrade-safe fallback behavior.

options.title: Prove and align the limit
options.body: Document or test the upstream WebSocket limit, use that contract as the bound, and add live redacted runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the stricter failure mode
options.body: Merge the 16 MiB cap only after explicitly accepting that larger existing WebSocket responses will fail instead of falling back to SSE.

options.title: Pause the guard
options.body: Keep the current decoder behavior until the provider contract and a safe failure strategy are established.

recommendation.title: Prove and align the limit
recommendation.body: Document or test the upstream WebSocket limit, use that contract as the bound, and add live redacted runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the active implementation and can supply the missing proof, while current-main area ownership was not established in the available history inspection.
